idea: LAC expands seeds with AES-256 in counter mode (hundreds of blocks per operation); the reference path of the port is the bitsliced software AES of PQClean/BearSSL, and the ESP32-C3 has an AES accelerator.
change: suites/lac/pqc_suite/lac_port.c: lac_aes256ctr uses suites/pqmagic_common/hwaes.c when the optimized variant is selected.
note: Key generation 8779 to 4401 us, LAC-256 encapsulation 31418 to 23087 us. Checked by equal fingerprints of ref and opt on the device and of device and host; LAC ships no test vectors and the port was not compared with an OpenSSL build of the original. Measured before the shared hardware SHA-256 was linked into this suite.
